effect_description_eng:
[Main] You may play 1 [Ghostmon] or [Violet Inboots] from your hand or trash without paying the cost. Then, place this card in the battle area.
[Your Turn] When any of your [Violet Inboots] suspend, ＜Delay＞ (By trashing this card after the placing turn, activate the effect below.)
・1 of your Digimon with the [Ghost] trait may digivolve into a Digimon card with the [Ghost] trait and [LIBERATOR] in the hand with the digivolution cost reduced by 3.
inherited_effect_description_eng: Security Effect [Security] Activate this card's [Main] effects.
